facts.claim: Explora III (Explora Journeys): Entered service 2026; 72,810 GT; 922 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 268 m length; Explora LNG class.

catalogSpecs.description: Third Explora Journeys ship and the brand's first LNG-powered vessel; enlarged hull vs Explora I/II. Entered service August 2026 after delivery from Fincantieri Sestri Ponente.
